Ancient Language: The language of magic; cannot be lied in
True name: The name of a thing in the Ancient Language; confers power over it
Rider: Bonded partner to a dragon, possessing magic and extended life
Brisingr: Fire — Eragon's first spell-word; also his sword's name
Urgal: Humanoid warrior species; complex cultural portrayal
Helgrind: The four-peaked rock; home of the Ra'zac
Galbatorix: The Mad King; fallen Rider and antagonist
Vault of Souls: Hidden enclave of Eldunarí and eggs
Fractalverse: Paolini's SF series (To Sleep in a Sea of Stars, Fractal Noise)
